name: Snapchat Ads
description: Let your AI work with your Snapchat ads: list organizations, ad accounts, campaigns, ad squads, ads, creatives and audiences, read impressions, swipes and spend per day or in total, and pause or restart a campaign after your confirmation. Signed in through an OAuth app of your own in Snap Business Manager.
instructions:
## Snapchat Ads
This connector works with Snapchat advertising through the **Snapchat Marketing API** (`https://adsapi.snapchat.com/v1`), signed in as one Snapchat Business user: organizations and ad accounts, campaigns, ad squads (ad sets), ads, creatives, audience segments and performance statistics. It can pause a campaign or turn it back on. It signs in with **OAuth 2.0** (authorization code) through an OAuth app of your own in Snap Business Manager. The Marketing API is open to every advertiser: no application or review by Snap is needed.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://business.snapchat.com as an **Organization Admin** (only admins see the OAuth app settings).
2. Open **Business Details** (or Business Settings) → **OAuth Apps** → create an app. Give it a name and set the **Redirect URI** to `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. Accept the Snap Developer Terms and Snap Business Tools Terms.
3. Copy the **Client ID** into `SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID` and the **Client Secret** into `SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET`. The secret is shown only once; if it is lost, create a new app.
4. Install the connector, click **Authorize with Provider**, sign in with the Snapchat account that has access to the ad accounts and approve.

**Scope requested**: `snapchat-marketing-api`. The connector sees what the authorizing user may see in Ads Manager; ad accounts that user has no role on answer 403.

**Start here**: `snapchat_list_organizations` lists the organizations with their ad accounts (ids, currency, time zone). Then `snapchat_list_campaigns` → `snapchat_list_ad_squads` → `snapchat_list_ads`, and `snapchat_get_stats` for numbers.

**Money is in micro-currency**: budgets, bids, spend caps and the `spend` metric are the amount times 1,000,000 in the ad account's currency (`spend: 12345678` is 12.35). Always convert before quoting.

**Statistics** (`snapchat_get_stats`): `entity_type` adaccounts, campaigns, adsquads or ads, plus its id. `granularity` TOTAL (default) or LIFETIME for one sum, DAY (at most 31 days) or HOUR (at most 7 days) for a series. DAY and HOUR need `start_time` and `end_time` on whole hours; for DAY on midnight in the ad account's time zone, e.g. `2026-10-01T00:00:00` to `2026-10-08T00:00:00`. `breakdown` splits by child entity (campaign on an ad account, adsquad on a campaign, ad on either). Default metrics are impressions, swipes and spend. Very large requests answer 400 E9001: ask for fewer fields or a shorter period. Figures become final 48 hours after the end of a day.

**Changes spend money: confirm first.** `snapchat_set_campaign_status` with ACTIVE starts spending, PAUSED stops delivery. Say which campaign and what will happen, and wait for the user's yes. It changes only the status (a JSON Patch); Snapchat re-checks the whole campaign and refuses invalid ones (`sub_request_error_reason`). `snapchat_set_campaign_daily_budget` is installed switched off.

**Tools**: `snapchat_get_me`, `snapchat_list_organizations`, `snapchat_list_ad_accounts`, `snapchat_get_ad_account`, `snapchat_list_campaigns`, `snapchat_get_campaign`, `snapchat_list_ad_squads`, `snapchat_get_ad_squad`, `snapchat_list_ads`, `snapchat_get_ad`, `snapchat_list_creatives`, `snapchat_get_creative`, `snapchat_get_stats`, `snapchat_list_audiences` (read); `snapchat_set_campaign_status` (change, confirm first); `snapchat_set_campaign_daily_budget` (switched off).

**Paging**: list tools take `limit` (50 to 1000, default 50) and return `next_link` while more exist; pass the `cursor=` value from that link as `cursor`. Answers wrap each entity with a `sub_request_status`; the connector unwraps them.

**Sign-in lifetime**: access tokens last one hour and are renewed automatically with the refresh token. Removing the user from the organization, or the app, ends the sign-in; then click **Authorize with Provider** again.

**Errors**
- 401 "unauthorized": the sign-in expired or was revoked; authorize again. Snapchat checks the token before the address, so a wrong id also shows as 401 when the token is bad.
- 403: the user has no role on that organization or ad account.
- 400 with `request_status: ERROR` and a `display_message` or `sub_request_error_reason` (e.g. E1165 or E1166 for a refused patch): read the message; it names the field.
- 429: too many requests; wait and try again.

**Out of scope**: creating or deleting campaigns, ad squads, ads and creatives, uploading media, targeting changes, the Conversions API, Public Profile API, pixels, billing and invoices, and asynchronous CSV reports.

SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID.label: OAuth Client ID
SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID.help: Snap Business Manager → Business Details → OAuth Apps → your app: Client ID.
SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Client ID only (a code like 4c3f2a18-1c33-4a1b-8798-0123456789ab), without spaces.

SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET.label: OAuth Client Secret
SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Shown once when the OAuth app is created in Snap Business Manager. If it is lost, create a new app.
SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Client Secret only, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Snapchat refused the access token. Click Authorize with Provider again; if the app was deleted or recreated, update SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID and SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET first.
verifyHints.403: The authorizing Snapchat user has no role on this organization or ad account. Give them access in Snap Business Manager, or authorize with another user.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Snapchat is rate limiting this app. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: A Snapchat Business account where you are Organization Admin, to create an OAuth app in Snap Business Manager with the redirect URI below, and a user with access to the ad accounts. About 10 minutes.

tools.name: snapchat_get_me
tools.description: Read the Snapchat Business user who authorized the connector: id, email, display name, organization id and member status. A cheap check that the sign-in works.

tools.name: snapchat_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the user belongs to, with their ad accounts (id, name, currency, time zone, status) when with_ad_accounts is true (default). Start here to find ad account ids.

with_ad_accounts.description: Include each organization's ad accounts (default true).

tools.name: snapchat_list_ad_accounts
tools.description: List the ad accounts of one organization: id, name, type, status, currency, time zone, advertiser and lifetime spend cap (micro-currency).

organization_id.description: Organization id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_organizations or snapchat_get_me.

tools.name: snapchat_get_ad_account
tools.description: Read one ad account: name, type, status, currency, time zone, advertiser and lifetime spend cap (micro-currency).

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

tools.name: snapchat_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of an ad account: id, name, status (ACTIVE or PAUSED), delivery status, objective, start and end time, daily budget and lifetime spend cap (micro-currency: divide by 1,000,000).

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the cursor= value inside next_link of the previous answer.

tools.name: snapchat_get_campaign
tools.description: Read one campaign: name, status, delivery status, objective, schedule, budget and spend cap (micro-currency).

tools.name: snapchat_list_ad_squads
tools.description: List the ad squads (ad sets) of a campaign: id, name, status, delivery status, type, placement, optimization goal, bid and budget (micro-currency), schedule and targeting.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the cursor= value inside next_link of the previous answer.

tools.name: snapchat_get_ad_squad
tools.description: Read one ad squad: status, delivery status, placement, optimization goal, bid, budget (micro-currency), schedule and targeting.

tools.name: snapchat_list_ads
tools.description: List the ads of an ad squad: id, name, creative id, status, delivery status, type and review status with rejection reasons.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the cursor= value inside next_link of the previous answer.

tools.name: snapchat_get_ad
tools.description: Read one ad: name, ad squad, creative id, status, delivery status, type and review status with rejection reasons.

tools.name: snapchat_list_creatives
tools.description: List the creatives of an ad account: id, name, type, headline, brand name, call to action, main media id, review status and web view URL.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the cursor= value inside next_link of the previous answer.

tools.name: snapchat_get_creative
tools.description: Read one creative: name, type, headline, brand name, call to action, main media id, review status and web view properties.

tools.name: snapchat_get_stats
tools.description: Read performance statistics of an ad account, campaign, ad squad or ad: impressions, swipes, spend and any other metric in fields, as one total or per day or hour. spend is in micro-currency (divide by 1,000,000). DAY and HOUR need start_time and end_time on whole hours (DAY on midnight in the ad account's time zone); DAY covers at most 31 days and HOUR 7 days. Metrics are final 48 hours after the end of a day.

entity_id.description: Id (UUID) of that ad account, campaign, ad squad or ad.

granularity.description: TOTAL (default, one total for the period), DAY, HOUR or LIFETIME.

fields.description: Comma-separated metrics (default impressions,swipes,spend). Others: video_views, screen_time_millis, quartile_1, quartile_2, quartile_3, view_completion, uniques, frequency, conversion_purchases, conversion_purchases_value, conversion_sign_ups, total_installs.

start_time.description: Start, ISO 8601 on a whole hour, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00 (in the ad account's time zone) or with an offset.

end_time.description: End (exclusive), ISO 8601 on a whole hour.

breakdown.description: Split by child entity: campaign (ad account only), adsquad (campaign only) or ad.

omit_empty.description: true to leave out days or entities with no data.

tools.name: snapchat_list_audiences
tools.description: List the audience segments of an ad account (customer lists, lookalikes, pixel and engagement audiences): id, name, description, source type, status, whether it can be targeted, upload status, approximate size and retention days.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: the cursor= value inside next_link of the previous answer.

tools.name: snapchat_set_campaign_status
tools.description: Pause a campaign (status PAUSED) or turn it back on (ACTIVE). Turning a campaign on starts spending its budget. Before calling, tell the user exactly what will change and wait for their yes. Only the status changes; Snapchat validates the campaign afterwards and refuses the change if it is invalid.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

tools.name: snapchat_set_campaign_daily_budget
tools.description: Change a campaign's daily budget, in micro-currency (e.g. 50000000 = 50.00 in the ad account's currency). This changes how much money is spent. Before calling, tell the user exactly what will change and wait for their yes. Installed switched off.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id (a UUID) from snapchat_list_ad_accounts or snapchat_list_organizations.

daily_budget_micro.description: New daily budget in micro-currency (amount times 1,000,000).
